Avail Sept 1/26 Min 1 Year Term Unfurnished Pet Friendly Secure Underground Parking Storage Locker in Parking Space Professionally Managed by Hello Rent Charming 2 bed+den+2 bath Kitsilano unit on the 3rd floor offers the feel and convenience of ground-level living. Positioned above retail space, the home opens directly onto a large landscaped courtyard with your own private patio. Comfortable practical layout with 2 well-sized bedrooms, 2 full baths, flexible den ideal for a home office, plus a large entry flex room for storage, pantry or gear. Located on W Broadway above London Drugs, surrounded by cafés, shops, restaurants, groceries and transit. Easy access to Kits Beach, waterfront routes, Downtown and UBC. Tenant insurance required at move-in. $200 move-in fee paid to Strata BCS667.

2268 West Broadway Avenue is in the city of Vancouver, British Columbia and situated in the neighbourhood of Kitsilano in Vancouver. Fairview Vw, Arbutus and Point Grey are nearby neighborhoods. While Broadway Avenue has no postings presently available, the community of Kitsilano has 217 properties for sale. That's just 4.59% of the 4,725 total listings on the market in the city of Vancouver. The average listed price of a property in Kitsilano is $1,990,611, with an estimated mortgage of $7,265 per month.* That is 1.6x the average list price of $1,244,670 in Vancouver. Homes listed in Kitsilano are an average of 1,473 sq ft, with 3 beds and 2 baths. The neighbourhood around 2268 West Broadway Avenue has more houses for sale than apartments.

* Monthly payments are an estimate based on a mortgage with 20% down @ 2.65% with a 5-yr Variable rate

On top of that, there are 415 Vancouver condos for rent. The list price of $3,600 is 0.01% lower than the average list price of $1,993,749 for Kitsilano real estate and 99.71% lower than the average list price of $1,244,670 for Vancouver real estate.
